fields.description: Untick to stop all AI transcription and summaries (the button will refuse to run).
fields.label: Enable AI call analysis
Gemini API Key
fields.description: Stored encrypted. Shown masked after saving; to change it, type a new key and save.

fields.options: Create a key at aistudio.google.com/apikey. It must belong to a billed Google project: on the free tier Google may use call audio to improve its products. Use Test connection (top of the page) before saving.

fields.description: Model that writes the summary and key insights.
fields.label: Summary Model
Thinking Level
fields.description: How much the summary model reasons before answering. Higher costs more.
Optional hints, e.g. hi-IN, en-IN (comma separated). Leave empty to detect the language automatically (best for Hindi/English mixing).
fields.label: Language Hints

fields.description: Off by default: the speaker turns currently come back without labels and run together, so the plain transcript reads better. Only used for calls up to 30 minutes (Google's limit).
fields.label: Speaker labels

fields.description: Write Hindi in Roman letters (Hinglish) if the transcript comes back in Devanagari.
fields.label: Romanize Hindi

fields.description: Product, brand and model names, comma separated, so they are spelled correctly in the summary.
fields.label: Glossary

fields.description: Calls shorter than this are refused (too short to contain a conversation).
fields.label: Minimum Call Length (seconds)

fields.description: Leave empty for no maximum. Google's speech model accepts up to 1 hour per call.
fields.label: Maximum Call Length (seconds)

fields.description: How many analyses one user can start per day.
fields.label: Daily Limit per User
